title: RS Boost Invite Code for ReelShort Creators
description: Free RS Boost invitation code for the ReelShort affiliate program, sent to your email on request. Where to paste it and what it does.
h1: RS Boost invite code (ReelShort affiliate program)
lead: Signing up for RS Boost, ReelShort's affiliate program for creators? The sign-up form has an invitation code box. We send our code by email to people who ask for it, together with the sign-up link and a short checklist. One email, no newsletter.
disclosure: This is our referral code. If you join with it, ReelShort may give us a better commission rate. It costs you nothing and does not change what you earn.

steps: Open the RS Boost sign-up page on cps.reelshort.com and choose to register.
Fill in the account details the form asks for.
Paste the code into the invitation code field.
Finish sign-up, then log in and set up your promotion links.
after: Treat the code as permanent: you may not be able to change it after sign-up. If you already have a code from someone you know, use theirs.

p: RS Boost is ReelShort's own program for people who promote its dramas. You share ReelShort dramas with a link or code from your dashboard, and you are paid on a cost-per-sale basis when your viewers pay in the app.
Swoonflicks is a small short-drama channel that uses RS Boost itself. The dramas below are ones we share.

sections.h2: This is not a viewer code
p: The RS Boost code is for creators signing up to promote dramas. It does not unlock episodes or add coins to a viewer account. ReelShort's app has a separate invitation code box for viewers.

Our guide: ReelShort invitation code for viewers

faq.q: Is the RS Boost invite code free?
faq.a: Yes. Invitation codes are free. Never pay anyone for one.

faq.q: Why do you send the code by email instead of showing it?
faq.a: We share it personally with people who are actually signing up, so it arrives with the sign-up link and the checklist in one place you can come back to. It is still free, and we send one email only.

faq.q: How fast does the email arrive?
faq.a: Usually within a minute. If it is not in your inbox after a few minutes, check spam or promotions, or write to partner@swoonflicks.com.

faq.q: Do I need an invitation code to join RS Boost?
faq.a: The RS Boost sign-up form has an invitation code field. If you have one, paste it there. Request ours with the form on this page and it arrives by email within a minute.

faq.q: Can I change my invitation code after I sign up?
faq.a: Plan as if you cannot. Pick the code you want before you finish sign-up.

faq.q: Does this code give me free coins on ReelShort?
faq.a: No. It is a creator sign-up code, not a viewer code. It does not unlock episodes or add coins.

faq.q: Does DramaCPS have an invitation code?
faq.a: No. DramaCPS does not use invitation codes. You sign up directly on its site.

faq.q: How much can I earn with RS Boost?
faq.a: We do not publish earnings figures. RS Boost pays on a cost-per-sale basis under its own terms, and your dashboard shows the rates that apply to you.
